integrity: Three standalone exhaustive finite algorithms and their exact stdout records are included. All 65,536 ordered pairs are checked, similarity orbits are independently enumerated, and nonstandard claims are supported by reproducible code. This is self-review, not external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result only for the binary rank-three special linear Lie algebra; no assertion for other field sizes or ranks. Older two-generation paper was available in abstract and secondary citations but its full text was not read; historical priority remains qualified.
title: Exact generating-partner spectrum of \(\mathfrak{sl}_3(\mathbb F_2)\)
